The component also supports the common properties [`id`](../common-properties/#id), [`hidden`](../common-properties/#hidden), [`grid`](../grid/), and [`pageBreak`](../page-break/).

| Property                                          | Type                           | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `type`                                            | `"Summary"`                    | Yes      |         | Identifies which component type this configuration represents.                                                                                               |
| `componentRef`                                    | `string`                       | Yes      |         | String value indicating which layout component (by ID) the summary is for.                                                                                   |
| `largeGroup`                                      | `boolean`                      | No       | `false` | Boolean value indicating if summary of repeating group should be displayed in large format. Useful for displaying summary with nested groups.                |
| `excludedChildren`                                | `string[]`                     | No       |         | Array of component IDs that should not be shown in a repeating group's summary                                                                               |
| `textResourceBindings`                            | `object`                       | No       |         | Connects component texts to text resources or expressions.                                                                                                   |
| `textResourceBindings.returnToSummaryButtonTitle` | `string \| expression<string>` | No       |         | Used to specify the text on the NavigationButtons component that should be used after clicking "Change" on the summary component                             |
| `display`                                         | `object`                       | No       |         | Optional properties to configure how summary is displayed                                                                                                    |
| `display.hideChangeButton`                        | `boolean`                      | No       | `false` | Set to true if the change button should be hidden for the summary component. False by default.                                                               |
| `display.hideValidationMessages`                  | `boolean`                      | No       | `false` | Set to true if the validation messages should be hidden for the component when shown in Summary. False by default.                                           |
| `display.useComponentGrid`                        | `boolean`                      | No       | `false` | Set to true to allow summary component to use the grid setup of the referenced component. For group summary, this will apply for all group child components. |
| `display.hideBottomBorder`                        | `boolean`                      | No       | `false` | Set to true to hide the blue dashed border below the summary component. False by default.                                                                    |
| `display.nextButton`                              | `boolean`                      | No       | `false` | Set to to true display a "next" button as well as the return to summary button                                                                               |
